title: Claude AI Skills Developer / Legal AI Workflow Specialist for Florida Family Law Firm

facts: Post requests custom Claude AI skills for a Florida-based family law firm: client intake, legal document drafting, case summaries, document analysis, reusable prompts/templates, firm procedures, privacy safeguards, validation, attorney review, and daily-use documentation.
No firm name, practice procedures, legal templates, actual matter data, approved privacy settings, or jurisdiction-specific legal sources were supplied.
Toor is a client contact first name repeated in three separate written reviews in intake-private.json. Ownership and legal role are not inferred.
All matter data, staff identity, source excerpts, procedure/template versions and output counts are fictional demonstration data. No past legal delivery or Florida-law expertise is claimed.
The page is an illustrative local demonstration. It does not install skills, process client data, transmit messages, or approve legal work.

{{matter.client}} reports separation in September 2026. The exact date remains unresolved [{{source.intake}}:4; {{source.chronology}}:3]. Financial information is incomplete because the referenced attachment is missing [{{source.chronology}}:6]. No legal conclusion is drafted.

{{artifact.draft}} · Factual section only: “I separated on [DATE TO BE CONFIRMED].” Draft note cites both conflicting passages. Remaining legal sections stay blank pending an attorney-approved form and instructions.
